connector.name: Investra Ai MCP
connector.registryDescription: Real estate investment intelligence: search, comps, cash flow, off-market leads, skip trace.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package investra-ai-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the perkinsandre account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: INVESTRA_API_KEY
env.description: Your Investra API key. Get one at https://www.investraapp.com/profile (Developer Settings). Format: starts with 'inv_' followed by 48 characters.

env.name: INVESTRA_API_URL
env.description: Optional override for the Investra API base URL. Defaults to https://www.investraapp.com. Set this only if you're running the Investra web app locally for development.
